text: XTB S.A. has been listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange since 2016. Its shareholder page (per current report 22/2026 of 7 September 2026) lists XX ZW Investment Group S.A. with 27.78% of shares and votes and other shareholders with 72.22%; XX ZW, seated in Luxembourg, is directly controlled by Jakub Zabłocki, who holds 81.97% of its capital and votes.
short: XTB S.A. trades on the Warsaw Stock Exchange; its largest shareholder, XX ZW Investment Group S.A., holds 27.78%.
